reply_text:
I told Ilse in our DM that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is **Bay 30**. I got that from her Oct 14 message in this DM, which she can see herself.

I couldn't get the saved preference back from gbrain. It refused the lookup and read nothing, because the connection isn't tied to any member, so it can't tell whose data it may show. Someone with admin access to the machine running gbrain needs to fix that by linking the connection to a member, or setting it up to act for several named members. It suggests running `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`. I didn't run that, since it changes who can read what in the brain. Until it's fixed, saved memories won't come back, so I'll keep answering from conversations the member can see.
